At the Kansai Economic Law Study Group (co-organized by the Kobe University innovation KAKENHI project), I gave a research presentation titled "The Basis and Challenges of Regulating Unilateral, Direct Refusals to Deal." An article of the same title is scheduled to appear in *Osaka Law Review* vol. 70, no. 5 in January 2021.
